entities.summary: Venadu , also romanised as Venad, was a medieval state located between the Western Ghat Mountains and the Arabian Sea, at the south-western tip of India, with its traditional capital at the port city of Kollam (Quilon). It was one of the major principalities of present-day Kerala, along with states of Kannur (Kolathunadu), Kozhikode, and Kochi (Perumpadappu) during the medieval and early modern periods.
